images.note: A modern stained-glass depiction of Clitherow; the window is in Loveland, Ohio, not York.

images.subject: York Minster
images.label: York
images.title: File:York Minster Nave.jpg
images.note: York Minster as it stands today; the medieval minster dominated the city in Fawkes's youth.
images.reason: The sentence asks what Guy Fawkes saw in York; the image shows York Minster, the city's defining landmark.

images.subject: Execution of the Gunpowder Plotters
images.label: The plot's aftermath
images.title: File:Anonymous - The Gunpowder Plotters and their Execution in February 1606 - B1977.14.17890 - Yale Center for British Art.jpg
images.alt: Engraving of the Gunpowder Plotters and their execution in February 1606
images.note: A period engraving of the plotters and their February 1606 execution; it shows the plot's aftermath, not Clitherow's 1586 death.
images.reason: The closing sentence links Clitherow's death to the 1605 plot; the engraving shows the plotters and their 1606 execution, the plot's outcome.
